templates.title: Hexahedral volume mesh to metre VTK
templates.description: Convert VTK-order eight-node hex/tetra volumes for a downstream CAE viewer; check signed volumes and field associations.

source.label: Source mesh
source.description: Choose supported ASCII VTU with VTK-order linear hexahedra, tetrahedra or triangles; coordinates declared in millimetres. Hex Jacobian samples must be positive.

templates.requires: Configure an isolated Python interpreter with meshio 5.3.5 and NumPy; select a bounded supported source mesh.
